indirapuram.name: Indirapuram
indirapuram.about:
Indirapuram is a planned trans-Hindon township in Ghaziabad, founded in 1996 and divided into named khands such as Ahinsa, Nyay, Shakti, Gyan, Niti, Abhay and Vaibhav Khand, most of them split into numbered pockets. Housing is a blend of high-rise group-housing societies, builder floors and independent houses. The township lies between NH-9 (the old NH-24, Delhi–Meerut road) and the Noida border, with Vasundhara, Vaishali and Noida Sectors 62 and 63 as neighbours. In 2024 the Ghaziabad Development Authority handed it over to the Ghaziabad Municipal Corporation, and it is now a municipal zone of its own.

Two Blue Line metro stations serve the area: Vaishali and Noida Electronic City, with e-rickshaws or shared autos for the last leg. Main roads such as Kala Pathar Road and Kaveri Marg are busiest at office hours, so evening tuition is easier to keep if it starts after the rush. In societies a tutor should expect gate registration; in the independent-house pockets they can usually come to the door. For specialist subjects, an online tutor is a practical choice. indirapuram-ahinsa-khand-1.name: Ahinsa Khand 1, Indirapuram
indirapuram-ahinsa-khand-1.about:
Ahinsa Khand 1 is one of Indirapuram's society-dominated pockets, where most families live in high-rise group-housing apartments rather than plotted homes. It adjoins Ahinsa Khand 2 and Vaibhav Khand, with Niti Khand 1 and the Shakti Khand pockets close by. Kala Pathar Road and Kaveri Marg are the roads residents use most, and the Delhi–Meerut Expressway (NE-3) is within easy reach for trips towards Delhi.

The nearest metro is Noida Electronic City on the Blue Line, and a shared auto or e-rickshaw usually covers the last stretch. Because almost every building here is a gated society, a tutor's first visit normally involves registering at the gate, so it helps to share the tutor's name and phone number with security in advance. Kala Pathar Road is slow around office hours, so late-afternoon or post-rush evening slots tend to be more reliable. indirapuram-ahinsa-khand-2.name: Ahinsa Khand 2, Indirapuram
indirapuram-ahinsa-khand-2.about:

Shakti Khand, Niti Khand and Nyay Khand lie around it, and Noida Sector 63 is just across the border. Dr Sushila Naiyar Marg, Kala Pathar Road and NH-9 link it with the rest of Ghaziabad and with the Noida Sector 62 office belt.

Noida Electronic City on the Blue Line is the closest metro station, and the Namo Bharat station at Sahibabad is another option for tutors coming from the Meerut Road side. CISF Road fills up with morning traffic, so weekday sessions are easier to schedule for the afternoon or evening. Tutors should expect society gate entry and visitor logging on every visit, so registering a regular tutor with security saves time. indirapuram-nyay-khand-1.name: Nyay Khand 1, Indirapuram

vaishali.name: Vaishali
vaishali.about:
Vaishali is a planned trans-Hindon locality on the Delhi–UP border, divided into numbered sectors and sitting between Kaushambi, Indirapuram and Vasundhara. vaishali-sector-2.name: Vaishali Sector 2

kaushambi.name: Kaushambi
kaushambi.about:
Kaushambi sits on the Delhi–UP border, directly opposite Anand Vihar, and comes under the Vasundhara Zone of Ghaziabad Municipal Corporation. Roads around RDC get crowded in the evening, so an early-evening slot is often easier to keep. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

kavi-nagar.name: Kavi Nagar
kavi-nagar.zone: Raj Nagar, Kavi Nagar & Old Ghaziabad
kavi-nagar.about:
Known locally as one of Ghaziabad's more settled residential addresses, Kavi Nagar is organised into lettered blocks and has builder floors, independent houses and villas, with an industrial area on one side. Neighbouring localities include Raj Nagar, Nehru Nagar, Ashok Nagar, Nasirpur and Vivekanand Nagar. Hapur Road, Tagore Road and Meerut Road carry most traffic, and New Ghaziabad railway station is the closest rail point.

Because most homes are plotted houses or floors, tutor visits are usually doorstep visits with no gate pass needed. Shaheed Sthal (New Bus Adda) on the Red Line is the nearest metro, so a tutor coming by metro normally takes an auto or e-rickshaw for the last stretch. Hapur Road can be slow at office hours, so weekday sessions set a little before or after the evening rush tend to start on time. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

shastri-nagar.name: Shastri Nagar
shastri-nagar.zone: Raj Nagar, Kavi Nagar & Old Ghaziabad
shastri-nagar.about:
Shastri Nagar is a block-based residential colony on the Hapur Road side of Ghaziabad, made up mostly of builder floors and independent houses. It adjoins Govindpuram, Avantika Colony and Mahindra Enclave, with Hapur Road and GT Road as the main links to the rest of the city. Blocks carry letter codes, which helps a tutor find the right lane quickly.

Plotted houses make home tuition simple: there is usually no society gate to clear and the tutor comes straight to the door. The nearest metro is Shaheed Sthal (New Bus Adda) on the Red Line and Ghaziabad Junction is the main rail station, so tutors without their own transport tend to finish the journey by auto or e-rickshaw. For specialist subjects that are harder to cover locally, parents here often combine a home tutor with online classes. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

nehru-nagar.name: Nehru Nagar
nehru-nagar.zone: Raj Nagar, Kavi Nagar & Old Ghaziabad
nehru-nagar.about:
Close to the older centre of Ghaziabad, Nehru Nagar is a busy residential locality where older buildings and builder floors dominate, with some apartments and independent houses. Its streets have an active commercial character. Nehru Nagar II and III, Ashok Nagar, Gandhi Nagar, Dayanand Nagar, Kavi Nagar and Ambedkar Road lie around it, and Ghaziabad railway station is close by.

For a tutor, the good news is that most homes open directly onto the street, so there is no gate registration to arrange. The flip side is that the commercial lanes get congested, so a slot that avoids the busiest market hours makes visits smoother. Tutors coming by metro can use the Red Line to Shaheed Sthal (New Bus Adda) or the Blue Line to Kaushambi and then take an auto or e-rickshaw. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

lohia-nagar.name: Lohia Nagar
lohia-nagar.zone: Raj Nagar, Kavi Nagar & Old Ghaziabad
lohia-nagar.about:
Lohia Nagar is a compact residential colony in central Ghaziabad, made up mainly of independent houses and small standalone buildings, with sub-areas such as A, B and C Blocks and Ram Garhi. It sits beside Patel Nagar, Maliwara and Jal Nigam Colony, with Raj Nagar close by. Hapur Road is the main road link, and both the old and new bus stands are within easy reach.

Families here usually get doorstep tuition, since independent houses need no society gate pass. Shaheed Sthal (New Bus Adda) and Hindon River on the Red Line are the nearest metro stations and Ghaziabad Junction is the nearest main railway station, so tutors from other parts of the city can combine metro or train with an auto for the last leg. Evening traffic on Hapur Road is the main thing to plan around when fixing a weekday time. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

patel-nagar.name: Patel Nagar
patel-nagar.zone: Raj Nagar, Kavi Nagar & Old Ghaziabad
patel-nagar.about:
Patel Nagar is one of the most transit-friendly pockets of central Ghaziabad. It is split into Patel Nagar 1, 2 and 3 and has independent houses along with some apartment buildings. Mohan Nagar, Sewa Nagar, Lohia Nagar and Naya Ganj are nearby, and GT Road and Meerut Road run close by. The Ghaziabad Namo Bharat station stands in Patel Nagar 2nd and links to the Red Line at Shaheed Sthal (New Bus Adda).

That transit access matters for tuition: a tutor coming from elsewhere in the city, or from along the Meerut corridor, can arrive by metro or Namo Bharat and walk or take an e-rickshaw the rest of the way. Most homes are houses or small buildings, so visits are usually doorstep visits without gate formalities. The junction area around Meerut Mod gets heavy traffic, so a tutor driving in should allow for peak hours. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sanjay-nagar.name: Sanjay Nagar
sanjay-nagar.zone: Raj Nagar, Kavi Nagar & Old Ghaziabad
sanjay-nagar.about:
Sanjay Nagar, widely known by its Sector 23, is a planned residential area on the northern side of old Ghaziabad with independent houses, flats and small standalone buildings arranged in numbered blocks. Raj Nagar, Kamla Nehru Nagar, Raj Nagar Extension and Raispur are nearby. Sanjay Nagar Main Road, ALT Road and Ambedkar Road are the main roads, and the District Combined Hospital is a well-known local landmark.

The block layout makes addresses easy to find, and most homes allow a tutor to come straight to the door. The Guldhar Namo Bharat station on Meerut Road serves Sanjay Nagar along with Raj Nagar and Raj Nagar Extension, while Shaheed Sthal (New Bus Adda) is the nearest Red Line stop. Tutors from further away can use either and finish by auto. Weekend mornings are often the easiest time for longer sessions. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

govindpuram.name: Govindpuram
govindpuram.zone: Raj Nagar, Kavi Nagar & Old Ghaziabad
govindpuram.about:
On the eastern edge of the city along Hapur Road, Govindpuram is a growing residential locality of independent houses, builder floors and a few apartment blocks, arranged in lettered blocks. Akash Nagar, Raispur, Shastri Nagar and the GDA township of Madhuban Bapudham are among its neighbours, and Raj Nagar and Kavi Nagar are within easy reach by road.

Metro access is limited here: Shaheed Sthal (New Bus Adda) on the Red Line is the nearest station but not close, so tutors usually travel by road. That makes a tutor who lives in Govindpuram or a neighbouring colony the most practical choice for regular home classes, with online sessions useful for specialist subjects or exam-season extra hours. Plotted houses mean no society gate formalities, and Hapur Road traffic is the main thing to plan around at peak times. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

nandgram.name: Nandgram
nandgram.zone: Raj Nagar, Kavi Nagar & Old Ghaziabad
nandgram.about:
Nandgram is an affordable residential locality on the Meerut Road side of north Ghaziabad, made up mostly of independent houses, plots and builder floors. It borders Ghukna, Noor Nagar and Sehani Khurd, with Raj Nagar Extension close by, and City Forest Park lies on the banks of the Hindon nearby. Meerut Road and the Raj Nagar Extension road are the main approaches.

The Hindon River and Shaheed Sthal (New Bus Adda) stations on the Red Line are the nearest metro points, and the Ghaziabad and Guldhar Namo Bharat stations are also within reach, so a tutor can come by train and take an e-rickshaw for the last stretch. Inside the colony the lanes are narrow and busy at peak hours, so parents often choose early-evening or weekend slots. Most homes are houses or floors, so visits are usually straight to the door. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

madhuban-bapudham.name: Madhuban Bapudham
madhuban-bapudham.zone: Raj Nagar, Kavi Nagar & Old Ghaziabad
madhuban-bapudham.about:
Madhuban Bapudham is a large planned township developed by the Ghaziabad Development Authority (GDA) on the north-eastern side of the city. Most of it is residential plots, with GDA-built flats, internal parks and community markets laid out in defined blocks. Govindpuram, Sadarpur, Raispur and Duhai are its neighbours, and Meerut Road is the main road nearby.

Because the township is still filling up, many streets have new independent houses, and tutors can usually visit door to door without gate formalities; GDA flat blocks may ask for a simple entry at the gate. The Guldhar and Duhai Namo Bharat stations and the Red Line at Shaheed Sthal (New Bus Adda) are the nearest rapid-transit links, but most tutors reach the area by road, so a tutor based in the township or nearby is often the easiest fit. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

raj-nagar-extension.name: Raj Nagar Extension
raj-nagar-extension.about:
Raj Nagar Extension grew over the last decade as one of the NCR's most active group-housing markets, and today it is mainly a belt of high-rise apartment societies north of old Raj Nagar, with some villas and builder floors. Its neighbours include Nandgram, Morta, Sehani Khurd, Ghukna and the Meerut Road Industrial Area. The Hindon Elevated Road links it to UP Gate on the Delhi border, and Meerut Road runs alongside.

For home tuition, society living means the tutor usually registers at the main gate, so parents should add the tutor's name to the visitor list in advance. The Guldhar Namo Bharat station on Meerut Road serves the area, and the Red Line's Hindon River and Shaheed Sthal (New Bus Adda) stations are the nearest metro stops, with an auto or e-rickshaw for the last leg. With many tutors living inside the societies, an in-society tutor can often be found. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

vijay-nagar.name: Vijay Nagar
vijay-nagar.about:
Vijay Nagar is a large residential, industrial and commercial area south of central Ghaziabad, spread along NH-9 (old NH-24) and the Delhi–Meerut Expressway. It is divided into Old and New Vijay Nagar, with numbered sectors and lettered blocks, Shivpuri, Ambedkar Nagar and a UPSIDC industrial zone. Homes range from independent houses and floors to newer apartment blocks. Pratap Vihar, Crossings Republik and Indirapuram lie close by.

Most of the older sectors are plotted, so tutors can usually come straight to the door; the newer apartment blocks may ask for gate registration. Shaheed Sthal (New Bus Adda) on the Red Line and Ghaziabad Junction are the nearest rail links. Traffic builds up near the highway junctions at office hours, so a session a little before or after the evening peak suits a tutor travelling in. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

pratap-vihar.name: Pratap Vihar
pratap-vihar.about:
A planned residential colony beside Vijay Nagar, Pratap Vihar has numbered sectors, including Sector 11 and Sector 12, with independent houses and some apartment complexes. It sits along the Delhi–Meerut Expressway corridor, with Siddharth Vihar, Crossings Republik, Indirapuram and Mohan Nagar nearby, and Leelawati Chowk is a well-known local landmark.

For most families here a tutor can come straight to the house, though apartment complexes will ask for a name at the gate. Ghaziabad Junction and Shaheed Sthal (New Bus Adda) on the Red Line are the nearest rail links, and the NH-9 expressway makes it easy for tutors from Indirapuram or Vijay Nagar to drive in. Expressway junctions get busy at office hours, so it helps to agree a slot that avoids the evening peak. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

siddharth-vihar.name: Siddharth Vihar
siddharth-vihar.about:
Siddharth Vihar is a newer residential belt on the NH-9 (old NH-24) side of Ghaziabad, next to Indirapuram and Pratap Vihar. Most homes are flats in gated high-rise societies, many of them recently completed or still being built, and the area is laid out along wide main roads. Crossings Republik and Vijay Nagar are also close by.

Society living means tutors are usually asked to register at the gate, so it helps to give the security desk the tutor's name and timing in advance. Shaheed Sthal (New Bus Adda) on the Red Line and Ghaziabad Junction are the nearest rail links, and most tutors come in by road along the expressway or from Indirapuram. As more families move in, finding a tutor who lives in the same society or next door is getting easier, and online classes cover specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

crossings-republik.name: Crossings Republik
crossings-republik.about:
Crossings Republik is an integrated high-rise township on NH-9 (the Delhi–Meerut Expressway) in Ghaziabad, built on land around the village of Dundahera and stretching towards Greater Noida. Along with Indirapuram, it is often described as one of Ghaziabad's two big sub-cities, and almost all homes are flats in gated group-housing societies. Vijay Nagar and Pratap Vihar are its nearest Ghaziabad neighbours.

For home tuition, every visit usually starts at a society gate, so parents should register the tutor with security before the first class. There is no metro inside the township; tutors mostly arrive by road along NH-9 or from Vijay Nagar. Because the population is large, many tutors live within the township itself, which makes regular evening classes easy to fit in. Online sessions are a practical option for specialist subjects or board-exam revision. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

Indirapuram.fact: Indirapuram was founded on 28 February 1996 as a residential sub-city in Ghaziabad.

The Ghaziabad Development Authority and the Ghaziabad Municipal Corporation signed an MoU in September 2024 to hand over Indirapuram, making it Ghaziabad's sixth municipal zone, with civic services and property tax moving to the corporation from 1 October 2024.
Under the handover agreement the GDA committed Rs 185 crore to the municipal corporation for Indirapuram's civic works.
Vaishali metro station, the terminus of the Blue Line branch, opened on 14 July 2011 and serves Vaishali, Vasundhara, Indirapuram and Khora.
Noida Electronic City metro station on the Blue Line opened on 9 March 2019 and serves Indirapuram as well as Noida, with an entry/exit on the Indirapuram side.
The Hindon Elevated Road, opened in March 2018, runs from Raj Nagar Extension to UP Gate on the Delhi border and connects to NH-24 (the Delhi–Meerut road).
Indirapuram is organised into khands (Ahinsa, Nyay, Shakti, Gyan, Niti, Abhay and Vaibhav Khand), several of which are subdivided into numbered pockets such as Abhay Khand 1 to 4.
The GDA has developed a new set of residential and commercial plots near Shakti Khand in Indirapuram, offered under its 2025 plot scheme.

Vaishali, Vasundhara & Kaushambi.fact: Vaishali and Kaushambi metro stations opened on 14 July 2011 on the Yamuna Bank–Vaishali branch of the Delhi Metro Blue Line; Vaishali is the branch terminus and Kaushambi the station before it.
Vaishali metro station stands on Madan Mohan Malviya Marg in Sector 4 and serves Vaishali, Vasundhara, Maharajpur, Indirapuram and Khora.
Kaushambi lies on the Delhi–UP border opposite Anand Vihar and falls under the Vasundhara Zone of Ghaziabad Municipal Corporation.

Anand Vihar Namo Bharat (RRTS) station opened on 5 January 2025; it is the only underground station on the Delhi–Meerut corridor and interchanges with the Blue and Pink Line metro, Anand Vihar Terminal railway station and the ISBT.
Sahibabad Namo Bharat (RRTS) station, on Madan Mohan Malviya Marg at Sahibabad Industrial Area Site 4, Vasundhara, opened to the public on 21 October 2023.
Vasundhara is a township under the jurisdiction of the UP Housing & Development Board (Awas Evam Vikas Parishad), Ghaziabad Circle.
Vaishali Sector 4 was developed by the Ghaziabad Development Authority as a planned residential sector.
The Hindon Elevated Road, opened in March 2018, links Raj Nagar Extension to UP Gate on the Delhi border and connects to NH-9 (old NH-24).

Sahibabad & Rajendra Nagar.fact: The Red Line extension from Dilshad Garden to Shaheed Sthal (New Bus Adda) serves eight stations: Shaheed Nagar, Raj Bagh, Major Mohit Sharma Rajendra Nagar, Shyam Park, Mohan Nagar, Arthala, Hindon River and Shaheed Sthal (New Bus Adda).
The Dilshad Garden to Shaheed Sthal (New Bus Adda) section of the Red Line was inaugurated on 8 March 2019, and passenger services began at 8 am on 9 March 2019.
Rajendra Nagar metro station on GT Road was renamed before it opened, in honour of Ashoka Chakra awardee Major Mohit Sharma.
Sahibabad Namo Bharat (RRTS) station, in Sahibabad Industrial Area Site 4 on the Delhi-Meerut RRTS, opened to the public on 21 October 2023.
The first Namo Bharat section, inaugurated on 20 October 2023, runs from Sahibabad to Duhai Depot with stations at Ghaziabad, Guldhar and Duhai.
Sahibabad is a group of industrial, residential and commercial areas under the Vasundhara Zone of the Ghaziabad Municipal Corporation, touching the Delhi and Noida borders.
Sahibabad Junction (station code SBB) is on the Kanpur-Delhi section of Northern Railway; the line splits there towards New Delhi via Anand Vihar and towards Delhi Junction via Shahdara.
Shalimar Garden lies north of GT Road and has three municipal wards (Main, Extension I and Extension II); Dilshad Garden (Delhi) is on its west and Loni Road forms its northern boundary.

Raj Nagar, Kavi Nagar & Old Ghaziabad.fact: Ghaziabad is split by the Hindon River into Trans-Hindon on the west and Cis-Hindon on the east.
The Delhi Metro Red Line extension from Dilshad Garden to Shaheed Sthal (New Bus Adda) was inaugurated on 8 March 2019, with passenger services from 9 March 2019.
Shaheed Sthal station, the Red Line terminus, is on GT Road near the New Bus Stand; it was originally called New Bus Adda and was renamed in 2019 in honour of the martyrs of 1857.

The Ghaziabad Namo Bharat (RRTS) station is in Patel Nagar 2nd, interchanges with the Red Line at Shaheed Sthal, and opened to the public on 21 October 2023; it is described as the tallest station in Delhi-NCR.
The priority section of the Delhi–Meerut RRTS between Sahibabad and Duhai Depot, including Ghaziabad and Guldhar stations, was inaugurated on 20 October 2023.
Guldhar Namo Bharat station, on Delhi–Meerut Road in the Meerut Road Industrial Area, serves Raj Nagar, Raj Nagar Extension and Sanjay Nagar.
Ghaziabad Junction railway station has been operating since 1864.

Raj Nagar Extension & NH-9 Corridor.fact: The Hindon Elevated Road connects Raj Nagar Extension with UP Gate on the Delhi border and was inaugurated on 31 March 2018.
The Delhi–Meerut Expressway stretch from the Delhi–UP border to Dasna was completed and opened to the public on 1 April 2021, built as 14 lanes (a 6-lane expressway plus an 8-lane highway).
Guldhar Namo Bharat station on Delhi–Meerut Road serves Raj Nagar Extension, Raj Nagar and Sanjay Nagar; it opened to the public on 21 October 2023.
Duhai Namo Bharat station was inaugurated on 20 October 2023 with the Sahibabad–Duhai section and opened to the public on 21 October 2023.

Crossings Republik is an integrated township on NH-24/9 (Delhi–Meerut Expressway), built on land acquired around the village of Dundahera between 2004 and 2009; with Indirapuram it is one of Ghaziabad's two big sub-cities.
Vijay Nagar is spread across NH-24 and the Delhi–Meerut Expressway, and includes Old and New Vijay Nagar, Shivpuri, Ambedkar Nagar and a UPSIDC industrial zone.
